subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats automatically provision per-sender subagents with isolated skills/config/memory, or should supported isolation remain sender/topic session scopes plus explicit agent bindings?
rationale: Current code has partial session and thread-binding infrastructure, but the requested default changes channel routing, agent lifecycle, config writes, per-user skills, memory boundaries, permissions, cleanup, and group reply semantics.

options.title: Define Feishu-owned contract first
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella product/security decision, then split implementation into narrow Feishu plugin and SDK tasks with live Feishu proof.

options.title: Limit support to session scopes
options.body: Treat group_sender and group_topic_sender as the supported current isolation model and close or rewrite automatic per-user subagents as out of scope.

options.title: Resolve primitives first
options.body: Finish the related channel threading, per-bot context, and skill-preference issues before revisiting automatic group subagents.

recommendation.title: Define Feishu-owned contract first
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella product/security decision, then split implementation into narrow Feishu plugin and SDK tasks with live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu product/security behavior and the plugin metadata identifies @m1heng as the Feishu community maintainer.
